zoe (finance): Quick follow-up: short duplicate-write window during a rebalance + overlapping re-ingest caused token inflation on ~2.4k invoices. Need owners for reprocess, PR, runbook updates, and customer comms. TL;DR + asks.

li (eng-ml): RCA: during a rolling deploy the producer batching key lost entropy across restarts. Some retries followed an alternate path and duplicated writes for ~3m. Repro script in gist.

sam (eng-sre): Containment: disabled alternate path at 04:12 UTC and paused auto-finalize. No new dup events since.

metering-bot: Created tickets BIL-7120 (reprocess-audit) and BIL-7121 (invoice-freeze). Linked to INC-91555. Affected CSV uploaded.

noel (platform): Reprocess plan (staging dry-run first): 1) identify invoices where COUNT(ev)>1 AND ABS(delta)>80 in window; 2) replay with strict dedupe; 3) produce audit CSV and ledger-hash diff for finance; 4) atomic apply. SQL to find candidates:

```sql
SELECT account_id, invoice_id, COUNT(*) ev_count, SUM(token_delta) sum_tokens
FROM metering_events
WHERE ingested_at BETWEEN '2026-06-10 03:00:00' AND '2026-06-10 03:10:00'
GROUP BY account_id, invoice_id
HAVING ev_count > 1 AND ABS(SUM(token_delta)) > 80
LIMIT 3000;
```

zoe (finance): Action items (please ACK with ETA):
- @noel (platform): run reprocess + validation (48h)
- @li (eng-ml): patch producer batching key + add chaos test (72h)
- @sam (eng-sre): rollout plan + runbook updates + invoice unfreeze checklist (24h)
- @maria (support): draft comms + impacted queue (EOD)
Finance will own credit approvals after audit CSV.

maria (support): ACK. Drafts to #support-drafts by 16:00 PT.

noel (platform): ACK. Will post staging diff before prod. Dry-run in 48h.

li (eng-ml): ACK. PR in ~6h. Adding metric metering.publish_dup_rate and alert.

sam (eng-sre): ACK. Runbook patch + rollout window in 6h. Prefer 02:00-03:30 PT FF canary.

metering-bot: Note: BIL-7121 will hold affected invoices from finalization until BIL-7120 sign-off.

zoe (finance): Thanks. I'll hold final invoice runs for affected accounts until sign-off and schedule a 20m remediation sync tomorrow 09:30 PT. React with :thumbsup: to confirm.
